title: Concept: OpenStack Swift container listing in a response
description: A container index document from a Swift endpoint in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The index names every object in the container along with its size and timestamp, which gives an attacker both the inventory and the change history.
applicability: Deployments that render a container index document from a Swift endpoint into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The index names every object in the container along with its size and timestamp, which gives an attacker both the inventory and the change history.
